scope.m: every positive proper divisor of n (k=n/m >= 2)

limitations: Finite checks do not prove the universal mathematical statements.
Finite checks do not prove asymptotic constants, uniformity, or limit laws.
The two-partition convex mixture is one finite example, not enumeration of all weights.
The all-partition definition is explicitly enumerated only through the stated smaller n cutoff.
No Lean code, compilation, or machine-checked formal proof is supplied.
independence_of_reference: Reference CV values fit majority on each actual training complement and count actual held-out mistakes for every binary label vector. Complete CV enumerates held-out subsets directly. Hypergeometric expressions are evaluated only as formulas under test.
